scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package-lock.json');if(p && p.packages && p.packages['node_modules/vite'] && !String(p.packages['node_modules/vite'].version).startsWith('5.')){console.log('Forcing reinstall due to vite version');process.exit(1)} }catch(e){ }" || (rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install)
scripts.prebuild:fix: node -e "try{const p=require('./package-lock.json');if(p && p.packages && p.packages['node_modules/vite'] && !String(p.packages['node_modules/vite'].version).startsWith('5.')){process.exit(1)} }catch(e){process.exit(0)}" || (echo 'Resetting to Vite 5.x' && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install)
